reader_summary.headline: Mitchell Green is the co-founder and managing partner of Lead Edge Capital.
reader_summary.overview: Mitchell Green is the co-founder and managing partner of Lead Edge Capital. Unlike most firms chasing power law outcomes, Lead Edge is designed to deliver consistent returns by talking to thousands of companies a year. In this conversation, Mitchell walks through every component of the machine, from how they source and evaluate companies to how they think about selling, building culture.
